findings.evidence: Line 1: cxxflags = ["-I../_shared_src", "-I$HOME/Games/KOTOR2_Mod_Workspace/tools/kotor-patch-manager/Patches/Common", "-Werror"]; line 4 repeats the same $HOME/Games/KOTOR2_Mod_Workspace path under [common_contract_test].
findings.suggested_investigation: Check whether the patch build tool performs environment-variable expansion on cxxflags entries (search its flag-processing code for the cxxflags reader). Then run the common_contract_test build with HOME pointed at a different directory, or on a clean checkout without the Games/ workspace, and confirm whether the -I path resolves. Compare against the other mods' test.toml files to see whether they use a repo-relative Common path instead.
findings.why_it_matters: The include path is hard-wired to one developer's workspace layout under $HOME. TOML does not expand $HOME, so unless the build tool expands it, the include silently points at a nonexistent directory on any other machine and the contract test fails to compile. Even where it expands, the path bypasses the repo's standard -I Common / -I../_shared_src include style, and the Common location is outside this repository.
